text:
Predicates:
Costs(x, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
Provide(x, y, z) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those y applicants who prove z.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
OutOfWork(x, y) ::: x has been out of work for more than y.
Apply(x, y, z) ::: x can apply for financial aid from y to take the z test.
Premises:
Costs(takeGRE, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
∀x (Provide(ETS, x, EconomicHardship(x))) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(tooLittleMoney) ∧ EconomicHardship(tooFewResources) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
SingleParentFamily(tom) ∧ OutOfWork(dad, year1) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family. His dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
Apply(tom, ETS, takeGRE) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
